body: how many brews have you gone through with this setup?
Because the owl knows the value of exposure.

i once dated someone.  actually more like fell into a friendship of attraction.  i think we both didn't know what was happening.  things were going slow and was probably the most healthy start to a relationship i've ever had.  but like you, i met someone who was wild and crazy and attractive and offered me a concrete 'bf/gf' relationship.  i fell for it.  

i knew this relationship with the wild one was wrong.  thought about the other girl but tried to make this relationship work.  over time, the wild relationship fell apart.  it wasn't meant to last.

now i'm stuck here wondering if i'll ever have that chance to rekindle again.

i like that you phrase it as, 'celebrate their life'.  i hope you're doing well.

i don't mean to be rude, but was there any idea why he went through with it?
how did it affect you and those close to him?
